name: read_three_bytes_packed
description: Reads three consecutive bytes from the address held in the address register and returns them packed into one value. No other input is used.

name: clear_word_if_matching
description: Clears a 16-bit field in a record when it equals the supplied value. The check is skipped when a global flag is zero and a threshold word is not greater than the supplied value, in which case the routine returns at once.

name: store_pointer_and_read_byte
description: Stores the address register in a global pointer, calls another routine, and returns the byte at that pointer. The called routine's result is ignored because the flag tested afterwards is always clear.

name: select_pointer_byte_when_zero
description: When the test word in a data register is zero, returns the byte at the address register; otherwise returns the value already in the result register.

name: select_pointer_word_when_zero
description: When the test word in a data register is zero, returns the word at the address register; otherwise returns the value already in the result register.

name: select_three_bytes_when_zero
description: When the test word in a data register is zero, returns three consecutive bytes from the address register packed into one value; otherwise returns the value already in the result register.

name: select_pointer_byte_when_nonzero
description: When the test word in a data register is non-zero, returns the byte at the address register; otherwise returns the value already in the result register.

name: dispatch_script_opcodes
description: Loops over a byte-coded command stream, branching on each opcode through a large switch. Some cases store a value or copy a null-terminated string into a buffer at an offset, and others trap or halt on bad data, so the decompiled control flow is only partly recoverable.

name: dispatch_script_opcodes_entry
description: Enters the same opcode loop as its sibling entry point, with the input registers passed in directly. It is called from two other routines, and its opcode cases store values or copy strings, with the decompiled flow partly corrupted.

name: dispatch_through_jump_table
description: Reads a byte from the address register, uses it as an index into a word table relative to a base register, and jumps to the routine at that address. The decompiler could not recover the table, so the targets are unknown.

name: forward_to_register_copy
description: Holds a single instruction that only calls a one-instruction routine copying one data register to another. The decompiler timed out, so nothing further is shown.

name: stub_decompile_timed_out
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The routine has eight instructions and is called from one other routine, and its behaviour cannot be determined from the evidence.

name: set_global_from_call_result
description: Calls one routine, then, when the input word is zero, replaces it with the result of a second call, or with 100 if a global flag is set. The word is then stored in a global variable.

name: process_character_by_mode
description: Handles one character code in a data register. When a global mode is zero it forwards the character to another routine; in modes one and two it treats newline, carriage return and space specially by adjusting global position words, and otherwise checks a window before calling a routine.

name: iterate_string_characters
description: Calls one routine, then calls another routine for each byte of a null-terminated string until the terminator is reached.

name: convert_integer_to_decimal_string
description: Writes a signed 16-bit value as a decimal string into the buffer at the address register, with a minus sign first when negative. It subtracts descending place values from a global table, suppresses leading zeros, and appends a terminating zero.

name: copy_record_fields_and_dispatch
description: Clears three global offset words and, when a flag byte is zero, copies a fixed set of record fields between structures while adding global offsets to some. It then enters the same opcode loop as the bytecode dispatcher, and the decompiled control flow is partly corrupted.

name: walk_record_list_and_update
description: When the first word at the address register is non-zero, calls a routine and skips past a null-terminated string. Otherwise it walks a linked list of records, calling routines for those that meet flag conditions, decrementing a countdown byte, and acting when it reaches zero, until the next link is zero.

name: allocate_slot_from_free_list
description: Marks a table slot as occupied, copies a 32-byte template into it, and takes the first node from a global free list, initialising its fields from the slot values. When the free list is empty it calls a fallback routine and returns.

name: store_byte_at_word_offset
description: Reads a signed word at offset two from the address register and uses it as an offset to store the byte at offset one into a buffer whose base is held in a global pointer.

name: set_global_flag_if_zero
description: Sets a global byte to one when it is currently zero, and leaves it unchanged otherwise.

name: update_word_if_different
description: Compares the word at the address register with a word at a fixed negative offset from the frame register, and copies the new value over the stored one when they differ.

name: clear_and_set_status_bits
description: Clears bit six and sets bit seven of a byte in a table, at an offset read from the address register, then calls two routines to finish the update.

name: append_node_to_list
description: Clears the link field of a node and appends it to the end of a singly linked list whose head is held in a global word. When the list is empty, the node becomes the head.

name: remove_node_from_list
description: Walks a singly linked list from a global head to find the given node, then points its predecessor at the node's own link. If the node is the head, the head is advanced to the next node instead.

name: compute_cross_product_components
description: Computes three signed byte cross-product components from six byte fields of a structure and stores them in three further byte fields of the same structure.

name: accumulate_delta_list_to_record
description: Walks a counted list of delta entries, adding their offsets to running totals and negating one component when a global flag is set. A special marker instead copies sixteen words into two buffers. The totals and packed fields are then written into an output record.

name: accumulate_delta_list_with_prefix
description: Builds a prefix byte from a flag and the input byte, then walks a counted list of delta entries into running totals in the same way as its neighbours. The shown body also copies sixteen words for a special marker and writes an output record.

name: accumulate_delta_list_masked
description: Masks the flag word, then walks a counted list of delta entries into running totals, negating one component when a global flag is set. A special marker copies sixteen words, and the totals are written to an output record.

name: accumulate_delta_list_long_body
description: Runs the same delta-list accumulation as its neighbours without the flag preamble. It walks a counted list of delta entries into running totals, handles a special marker by copying sixteen words, and writes the results to an output record through several calls.

name: probe_list_node_match
description: Reads a link at an offset from the base register and tests whether the node there has a word and a byte matching a frame word and the global byte. Every branch returns without changing anything, so the shown code has no visible effect.

name: compare_table_entry_match
description: Compares a word and a byte of a table entry at an offset against a frame word and a global byte. Both outcomes return immediately, so the routine leaves no visible effect in the shown pseudo-code.

name: search_sorted_node_list
description: Walks a linked list from a head word held in the frame, comparing each node's word key with a frame word and its byte with the global byte. It stops at the end of the list or when the keys pass the search value, and returns no result.

name: allocate_node_into_list
description: Takes the first node from a global free list and fills its key fields from a word, a frame word and the global byte, then writes a full status byte. It links the node into a list after the node named by a table value, and if the free list is empty it calls two routines and stores a value in the frame.

name: compute_scaled_position_offset
description: Takes the difference between a stored position and a reference position, scales the horizontal and vertical differences by a shift and a division by a third component, and adds them to the reference position. It then looks up an entry in a secondary table and stores the final coordinates and that third component in global words.

name: select_flag_or_status_byte
description: When the signed byte at offset one from the address register is negative, returns the incoming values unchanged. Otherwise it returns a byte at offset thirty-six of the record, combined with the incoming high word.

name: lookup_indexed_table_pointer
description: When the global flag is zero, follows two offset pointers from the frame record and indexes a table by a word multiplied by four, returning the resulting address. When the flag is set it returns the result of another routine.

name: calculate_indexed_table_pointer
description: Follows two offset pointers from the frame record and indexes a table by a word multiplied by four, returning the resulting address. It calls one routine to obtain the word used for the index.

name: set_flag_and_run_loop
description: Calls one routine, stores the input byte in a global flag, and then calls routines in a loop until a condition on that byte is met. It clears the flag before returning.

name: process_until_zero_result
description: After checking a word at a frame offset, calls a routine repeatedly while the word it returns is non-zero. It then clears a global flag and returns.

name: unlink_node_mark_or_free
description: When a global flag is zero and the node's status byte is non-negative, marks the status byte as one and unlinks the node from its list. Otherwise it unlinks the node, pushes it onto a global free list, calls another routine and returns its byte result.

name: unlink_node_from_group_list
description: Removes a node from a group's linked list. The group head is found through a link at offset two of the node, and the node's next link at offset six replaces the predecessor's link, or the head link when the node is first.

name: save_position_pair
description: Copies the first two 32-bit values of the frame record into two global variables, saving a position for later comparison.

name: apply_coordinate_offset
description: Computes the difference between three frame coordinates and the saved global values. When any component differs, it adds that difference to the three coordinates of each node in a list, and sets a node's status byte to two when it was zero.

name: offset_node_coordinates
description: Adds three stored offset words to a node's three coordinate words. It then walks the rest of a linked list, setting the status byte of flagged nodes to two when it was zero, and finally clears the top bit of the node's status byte.

name: copy_bounds_and_process_nodes
description: Resets several global bytes and copies four words of bounding values from one table to another. It then walks the global node list, calling a routine for each node without a particular status bit, and ends with a conditional pass that adjusts global flags.

name: update_node_bounds_list
description: Sets global flags from the status bits of a node and, when a bit is set, copies bounding words from the node. It walks a list of nodes, moving some onto a global free list and recording bounds for others, and it refreshes the bounds words when a flag is negative. The shown control flow is partly truncated.

name: store_node_state_fields
description: Writes a word link and a block of state values into a node at an offset: two 32-bit values, a word and the global byte. It calls routines before and after the writes.

name: unlink_and_free_node
description: Copies the next link of a node into its predecessor's link field, then pushes the removed node onto the head of a global free list.

name: store_node_state_with_links
description: Writes a link word and the same block of state values as its neighbouring routine into a node. It makes two calls before the writes and two after.

name: initialize_global_bounds
description: Sets two global bound words to the largest positive value and two others to the most negative value, ready for bounds to be expanded.

name: expand_global_bounds
description: When a node's status word is non-negative, widens four global bound words so they include the node's position and extent read from its record. A bound changes only when the new value lies beyond the current limit.

name: insert_node_in_sorted_list
description: Walks a linked list to find the insertion point that keeps nodes ordered by a word key, then by two byte keys. It links the given node there and clears its status byte.

name: process_flagged_node_pass
description: Returns at once when a node's flag bit is set. Otherwise it walks the global node list, calling routines for nodes that pass a status and bounds test, then updates a global status flag and calls routines depending on that flag and a second flag bit.

name: append_bounds_record_words
description: Writes four global words into the buffer whose write position is held in a global pointer, then advances that pointer by eight bytes. When the pointer reaches a fixed limit it calls another routine.

name: copy_table_block
description: Walks a table of four-word entries from a fixed starting address up to a limit held in a global. It copies each entry into four global words and calls a routine for each one.

name: clamp_rect_to_bounds
description: Tests whether a node's rectangle overlaps the global clip bounds. If it does, it stores the overlapping part in four global words and sets a global flag to one; otherwise it sets the flag to zero.

name: expand_rect_bounds
description: Checks whether a node's rectangle overlaps a range formed from a table entry and global values. If it does, it widens four global bound words to include that rectangle and sets a flag; otherwise it clears the flag.

name: update_clip_region_intersection
description: On first use, takes the stored clip bounds from a node's rectangle. For each node it intersects the node's rectangle with the current clip bounds, stores the intersection in four global words, rounds the horizontal edges to a 16-unit grid, and computes a buffer offset from the top row and a row stride.

name: stub_return_only
description: A routine that only returns. It is called from one other routine and has no effect.

name: copy_counted_block_reversed
description: Copies a counted block into the destination working from its end toward its start. A count word from the source is used to write one byte, then a word at a time, while the source pointer moves forward through the data.

name: stub_return_only
description: A routine that only returns. It is called from one other routine and has no effect.

name: clear_status_bit_zero
description: Clears bit zero of a status byte in the frame record at a fixed negative offset.

name: clear_status_bit_one
description: Clears bit one of a status byte in the frame record at a fixed negative offset.

name: store_global_byte_after_call
description: Calls one routine, then stores the input byte into a global variable.

name: set_global_to_one
description: Calls one routine, then assigns a masked two-bit value to a global variable and immediately overwrites it with one, so the global ends as one.

name: set_row_pointers_from_global
description: Sets two global pointers to an address computed from the global byte, scaled by thirty-two and offset from the base of the global area. It returns the incoming value of the first register unchanged.

name: reset_global_variable
description: Sets a global variable to zero through a series of assignments, the last of which leaves it zero.

name: check_nibble_sum
description: Adds the low nibbles of two input words and compares the sum with fifteen. Both outcomes return without changing anything, so the shown code has no visible effect.

name: check_nibble_difference
description: Subtracts the low nibble of one input word from the low nibble of the other and tests the result for negative and for a range check. Every branch returns without changing anything, so the shown code has no visible effect.

name: copy_state_buffers_and_set_flags
description: Returns early when a global mode is one of a set of values. Otherwise, depending on a sign test, it copies a 64-word block between global buffers or copies a counted run of words from a source, then sets a series of global values, including one derived from a shifted input count.

name: merge_nibble_buffers_backwards
description: Walks 64 words from last to first, comparing each word in one buffer with its counterpart in another. Where they differ, it picks the lower or higher nibble of each position through calls to a routine, then packs three selected nibbles into a new word in the second buffer.

name: copy_counted_run_and_set_flags
description: Returns early when a global mode is one of a set of values. Otherwise it copies a counted run of words from a source into a work buffer, then sets global values from a shifted input count, and sets a series of fixed global values when that input is zero.

name: forward_call_only
description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine and returns, with no other effect.

name: forward_call_only
description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine and returns, with no other effect.

name: store_command_block_and_ratio
description: Stores a word from the frame record and a byte and words from the input into global variables, with calls between the stores. When the input word is non-zero it computes a scaled ratio of the global byte to that word, stores its negative, and sets a global flag before a final call.

name: write_command_record_by_type
description: Chooses a record layout by comparing a global code with a set of values, then writes a tag byte and fields taken from the global variables into a buffer. Other codes are resolved through calls to other routines, and a final tag byte is set in the record. The decompiled control flow is partly corrupted.

name: init_bounds_and_accumulate_list
description: Copies two stored position pairs into bounds globals and computes a bounds width. It then either writes an output record from a counted list of delta entries, or for a special marker copies sixteen words into buffers, calling other routines throughout.

name: accumulate_delta_list_record_pass
description: Walks a counted list of delta entries into running totals, negating one component when a global flag is set, and then writes the totals into an output record. A special marker copies sixteen words instead, and the routine ends by clearing global flags.

name: clear_global_after_calls
description: Calls four routines in sequence, then clears a global variable.

name: forward_call_only
description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine and returns, with no other effect.

name: dispatch_through_jump_table
description: Reads a byte from the address register, uses it to index a word table relative to the base register, and calls the routine at that address. The decompiler could not recover the table, so its targets are unknown.

name: swap_pointers_and_dispatch
description: Swaps two saved 32-bit values held in globals, then dispatches through a word table indexed by a byte from the address register and calls the routine at that address. The table could not be recovered, so its targets are unknown.

description: A routine that only returns. It performs no work and has no effect.

name: calculate_weighted_sum
description: Accumulates a sum of products by walking one sequence forward and a second sequence backward over a counted length, starting from a base value. It returns the total.

name: forward_call_only
description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine and returns, with no other effect.

description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine and returns, with no other effect.

name: call_and_discard_compare
description: Calls one routine, then compares two register words for inequality. Both branches return, so the comparison has no effect.

name: call_and_discard_equal_compare
description: Calls one routine, then tests two register words for equality. Both branches return, so the test has no visible effect.

name: call_and_discard_less_compare
description: Calls one routine, then tests whether one register word is less than another. Both branches return, so the test has no visible effect.

name: call_and_discard_less_compare_reversed
description: Calls one routine, then tests whether the second register word is less than the first. Both branches return, so the test has no visible effect.

name: call_and_discard_at_most_compare
description: Calls one routine, then tests whether one register word is not greater than another. Both branches return, so the test has no visible effect.

name: call_and_discard_at_most_compare_reversed
description: Calls one routine, then tests whether the first register word is not greater than the second. Both branches return, so the test has no visible effect.

name: store_call_result_word
description: Calls one routine and stores its 16-bit result in a global variable.

name: compute_linear_congruential_step
description: Multiplies the low 16 bits of the input register by a fixed constant, adds a second fixed constant, and returns the 32-bit result.

name: call_when_global_zero
description: Calls one routine only when a global variable is zero. Otherwise it returns immediately.

name: call_when_global_zero
description: Calls one routine only when a global variable is zero. Otherwise it returns immediately.

name: call_when_global_zero

name: dispatch_by_code_range
description: Returns at once for codes zero to three. Code four walks a linked list to its end, codes 65 to 72 and 97 to 104 each call one routine, and all other codes return without action.

description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine and returns, with no other effect.

name: loop_calling_routine_forever
description: Calls one routine in an endless loop, so control never returns from this routine.

name: store_byte_at_offset
description: Stores the input byte into memory at the frame base plus the signed word read from the address register.

name: store_word_at_offset
description: Stores the input word into memory at the frame base plus the signed word read from the address register.

name: store_table_byte_at_index
description: Calls one routine to obtain an index, then stores the low byte of the word at the source pointer into memory at the frame base plus that index.

name: write_byte_at_unsigned_offset
description: Writes the input byte into memory at the frame base plus an unsigned byte read from the address register.

name: write_word_at_unsigned_offset
description: Writes the input word into memory at the frame base plus an unsigned byte read from the address register.

name: stub_decompile_timed_out
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The routine has seven instructions and makes one call to another routine, and nothing more can be determined from the evidence.

name: add_byte_at_offset
description: Adds the input byte to the byte stored at the frame base plus the signed word read from the address register, and writes the sum back.

name: add_word_at_unsigned_offset
description: Adds the input word to the word stored at the frame base plus an unsigned byte read from the address register, and writes the sum back.

name: pass_call_result_to_routine
description: Calls one routine that returns a 64-bit value, passes that value to a second routine, then calls a third routine.

name: copy_two_strings_into_buffer
description: Copies a null-terminated string from a global buffer into a destination, writes one control byte, then appends a second null-terminated string taken from a pointer in a global, ending with a zero. The referenced text is a disk device prefix and a file name.

name: initialize_data_structures
description: Sets several global pointers and fixed words, including limit values of 319 and 199 stored in a record. It then fills a table of pointers, stepping by 36 bytes, until a limit is reached.

name: build_name_with_mode_extension
description: Copies a name string into a buffer and replaces the character after its last period with a letter chosen from a global mode. It then runs a sequence of setup calls, and when a second value is non-zero it stores that value and calls further routines.

name: run_global_mode_loop
description: Sets a global variable to one and, unless a masked value matches a fixed value, sets a second global to one or to eight depending on a bit. It then enters an endless loop that calls routines and processes counted runs of data.

name: read_byte_with_fallback_pointer
description: When a limit value is at or above the address register, calls a routine and reads from a fallback pointer instead. It then returns the byte at the chosen address.

name: write_byte_with_bounds_check
description: Writes the input byte to a computed address derived from a global base, a frame value and a word offset. The write is skipped when a range test on the frame value holds and the word offset is not positive.

name: decode_back_reference_stream
description: Decodes a packed byte stream into an output buffer. Each control value either writes literal bytes obtained from a routine or copies a run of earlier output bytes to the current position, with run lengths read through repeated calls. Decoding stops when the output pointer passes the end limit.

name: negate_negative_difference
description: Subtracts two byte values. When the result is non-negative it returns the first value; otherwise it calls a routine if a limit is met, then returns the negated difference.

name: invoke_and_return_pair
description: Calls one routine and returns the two 32-bit input registers combined into one 64-bit value.

name: search_sorted_table
description: Binary searches a table of pointers to words for the value in the data register, using a count held in a global. It returns once the value is found or the search range becomes empty.

name: initialize_list_structure
description: Walks a memory range in steps of six bytes, writing each entry's step offset and a zero long. It then clears a word and sets two global list values to one and six.

name: insert_sorted_entry_or_init_node
description: Rounds a size up to an even value and advances a global pointer by it. It then inserts a pointer into a sorted table by its key word and increments a count, or, past the count limit, takes a node from a free list and initialises it from an input record, calling routines along the way. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: take_free_node_and_init
description: Moves a node to the head of a list and increments a count. When the count is within its limit it initialises the node from an input record and zeroes its extended words, and otherwise it calls a routine. The decompiled body is truncated.

name: init_node_from_record
description: Initialises a new node from an input record: it sets the node's link to the record's extended area, copies a few record fields and flags into it, zeroes its extended words and computes position fields. It is called from two other routines, and the rest of the decompiled body is truncated.

name: test_flag_bits_and_call
description: Tests bits eight, nine and ten of an input word and calls routines accordingly. It loops while a call returns a negative value, and otherwise returns the word.

name: forward_call_only
description: A thin wrapper that calls one other routine and returns the input register unchanged.

name: retry_until_nonnegative
description: Calls one routine and returns its result once it is non-negative. While the result is negative it calls a second routine and tries again.

name: store_until_nonnegative
description: Calls one routine and stores its result in a global. While the stored value is negative it calls a second routine and tries again, then returns the input register.

name: store_until_nonnegative
description: Calls one routine and stores its result in a global. While the stored value is negative it calls a second routine and tries again, then returns the input register.

name: retry_until_nonnegative
description: Calls one routine and returns its 64-bit value once the first result is non-negative. While that result is negative it calls a second routine and tries again.

name: run_global_countdown_checks
description: Sets a global counter and steps it through a small countdown, calling routines at its transitions. It then tests four pointer and flag pairs, calls routines for those that pass, and clears the global before returning.

name: advance_global_state_machine
description: Returns at once when a global is negative. Otherwise it either initialises the global to minus one with a second word, or advances it as a countdown, calling routines when a stored value changes, and finally sets the global to a fixed value.

name: decrement_and_clamp_value
description: Decrements a counter in a record. While the counter stays non-zero it adds one field into another, clamping the sum to 32767, then advances a third field and calls a routine. Otherwise it resets several record fields to zero and calls a routine.

name: call_four_routines
description: Calls four routines in sequence and returns.

name: reset_memory_block
description: Clears two bytes and two words of a record at the address register, and sets one byte to 128. It has no other effect.

name: initialize_state_with_error_text
description: Clears a global, calls several routines including one with two register arguments, sets two global words to fixed constants, and calls further routines. The referenced text is the word Error followed by a space.

name: setup_screen_buffers_and_limits
description: Sets several global pointers from a record and allocates buffers through a library call, zeroing a four-long block. It stores display limit words of 319 and 199 and a pair of 80 values, then calls a routine before returning. The referenced library calls include screen and window functions.

name: copy_block_and_start_copper_dma
description: Copies a block of words from one buffer into another, sets several global pointers into the copied area, and then calls routines that point the copper list at a new address and enable DMA with a fixed control value. The facts list the task forbid and permit calls and the copper and DMA control registers.

name: find_value_in_table
description: Scans a table of words, taken every four bytes from a base address, for the value in the data register. It returns the step count of the first match, or -1 if none matches.

name: find_value_in_table
description: Scans a table of words, taken every four bytes from a base address, for the value in the data register. It returns the step count of the first match, or -1 if none matches.

name: stub_return_only
description: A routine that only returns. It performs no work and has no effect.

name: apply_scaled_transform
description: When the input index is non-negative, multiplies a stored word by a scale value, adds four consecutive 32-bit values from a source, and writes each sum as two words into a table with a stride of eight bytes. The facts list the interrupt enable register as touched.

name: update_pointer_and_string_tables
description: Walks four table entries and stops early at a limit of 200. For each non-zero entry it writes a character code and a byte of fifteen into a text buffer, advancing by 108 bytes, and it sets pointers from offsets and stores each value. It then terminates the text with two bytes of minus one and calls two routines.

name: stub_return_only
description: A routine that only returns. It performs no work and has no effect.

name: call_indirect_function
description: Calls a function through a pointer held in a memory location and returns the input register. The facts list the graphics library's SetRast call.

name: wait_until_flag_bit_set
description: Loops until bit four of a global byte is set, then returns. The facts list a custom chip register as touched, but the loop itself only polls the global.

name: wait_for_flag
description: Loops until the lowest bit of a global byte is set, then returns. The facts list the vertical position register as touched.

name: set_interrupt_enable_bit
description: Calls two routines, then sets a global byte to sixteen. The facts list the interrupt enable register as touched, where a write with the top bit set enables interrupts and other writes disable them.

name: update_pointer_table
description: Walks three entries of pointers and words from a table. For each entry it writes four transformed values into a destination, each a stored word times a scale value plus a 32-bit source value, written as two words with a stride of eight bytes.

name: write_setup_bytes_and_call_library
description: Sets a flag bit in a global, writes two bytes into a buffer at a stored pointer, and calls several routines. It then sets a global to 1920, calls a library routine through a table pointer and stores its result. The referenced text is the file name BLANC.SND, and the facts list the system-state calls and the joystick, fire button and interrupt registers.

name: call_library_with_saved_state
description: Calls two routines, sets a global to fifteen and then to 1920, and calls a library routine through a table pointer. It then restores a saved global and calls a second library routine. The facts list the DMA and interrupt enable registers.

name: clear_global_and_call_pointers
description: Clears a global variable, calls a routine through a table pointer indexed by it, and saves the returned value in another global. It then stores a routine address in the global and calls it through a further table pointer.

name: call_library_pointer_pair
description: Calls a library routine through a table pointer, stores a saved global into another global, then calls a second library routine with an argument. The facts show the system-state calls.

name: increment_counter_and_call_routines
description: Increments a global counter, calls one routine, then calls another routine four times in a loop before calling three more routines.

name: set_global_to_thirty_two
description: Sets a global byte to thirty-two. The facts list the interrupt enable register as touched, but the code itself only writes the global.

name: update_channel_state_bits
description: When a global byte is zero, looks up a per-channel entry by index and, when its countdown byte reaches zero, sets the global bit for that channel in two shifted forms. The facts list the DMA control and interrupt enable registers.

name: update_channel_parameters
description: When a global byte is zero, updates per-channel parameters from a record. When the record's mode byte is zero it sets a channel bit in a global; otherwise it computes two values from the record and stores them into the channel's registers along with a global mask. The facts list the DMA control register.

name: decode_nibble_tagged_entries
description: When a global bit is set, walks a list of tagged entries. For entries with type codes one or two and a flag set, it copies a counted block of words between buffers in rows of 40 words, then rebuilds each byte's two nibbles through a lookup table and a running sum. Each processed entry's length field is reduced by two.

name: transpose_bitplane_entries
description: Walks a list of entries and rearranges their word data in rows. In one mode it gathers matching bits from groups of four words into four output buffers, which transposes bit planes; the other mode copies the planes. The decompiled body is truncated, so the second path is only partly visible.

name: return_constant_3000
description: Returns the constant 3000 and does nothing else.

name: replicate_global_byte
description: Returns a word made by placing the global byte in both halves of the result. The facts list the CIA timer register as touched, but the code only reads the global.

name: stub_return_only
description: A routine that only returns. It performs no work and has no effect.

name: copy_pointer_list_blocks
description: Walks a list of up to four source and destination pointer pairs, stopping at a null source. It copies sixteen words from each source to its destination, and for the first pair it also copies a further sixteen words.

name: call_write_pixel_library
description: Calls one routine, then calls the graphics library's WritePixel function through a library pointer. The input registers are returned unchanged.

name: call_draw_and_move
description: Calls one routine, then calls the graphics library's Draw function and then its Move function through library pointers, passing the library base to Move. The input registers are returned unchanged.

name: call_rect_fill
description: Calls one routine, then calls the graphics library's RectFill function through a library pointer. The input registers are returned unchanged.

name: stub_return_only
description: A routine that only returns. It performs no work and has no effect.

name: store_byte_and_set_apen
description: Stores the low byte of the input register in a global variable, then calls the graphics library's SetAPen function through a library pointer. The input register is returned unchanged.

name: store_byte_and_set_bpen
description: Stores the low byte of the input register in a global variable, then calls the graphics library's SetBPen function through a library pointer. The input register is returned unchanged.

name: store_drawing_mode
description: Stores the input byte in a global variable, mapping the value three to four, then calls the graphics library's SetDrMd function through a library pointer. The input register is returned unchanged.

name: iterate_until_value
description: Calls one routine repeatedly until it returns a non-zero byte, then calls another routine repeatedly until it returns zero. It returns the first result.

name: handle_text_character_output
description: Handles one character. A carriage return advances a horizontal counter by eight, a newline resets the column counter, and any other character wraps the column at 360 before it is stored in a global and drawn through the graphics library's Move and Text functions. The counters are kept in globals.

name: traverse_string_null
description: Calls one routine for every non-zero byte of a string, stopping at the terminator, and returns zero.

name: calculate_scaled_offsets
description: Clamps the first input to at most 39 and the second to at most 24, then stores them multiplied by nine and eight in two global words.
